assets.context: Suburban Neighborhoods developed primarily in the latter half of the 20th Century. These areas are characterized by lower density development, including neighborhoods of single-family development on lots of various sizes and more spacious setbacks between homes than found in older areas of the City with a generally uniform front setback within each square. Commercial areas within the Suburban Neighborhoods tend to be physically separated from residential areas and have few, if any, ground floor residential uses. These areas are generally located along arterial streets and typically provide accommodation for the automobile, reflecting a more suburban style of development.
